QorCap v0.3.36: Rumble Echo tuning

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged. Defaults are the v0.3.35 behaviour.

- [#110](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/110): `qorcap align-ab DIR --rumble-echo` takes `--re-pair-tol-ms`, `--re-max-lag-ms`, `--re-quiet-ms`, `--re-onset-threshold`, `--re-spike-threshold`, `--re-spike-pct`, and `--re-mode hist|strongest`. `--re-hist` prints the lag histogram with a chance column, and `--re-sweep` prints a 36-row parameter grid (stderr and report only; `rumble_echo.json` holds the selected parameters). Same gates and chance check; sidecar only; nothing is sent to the controller.
